Conflict in piling and utilities at…
The piling layout in revision B puts pile P-17 inside the route
of the fuel gas line 47-P-101, and the utilities drawing shows
the same corridor for the cooling water return. Please confirm
which of the two keeps the corridor, whether the pile can move
400 mm to the east without a new load… (Enter for all)
